instructions.content: Treat the Complex domain as one where cause-effect is only visible in retrospect: probe to sense patterns, not to prove
If the arguments reference a probe-to-probe handoff file, load it before Phase 1 so carried context speeds up qualification
After every AskUserQuestion call, check for empty answers; if empty, do NOT proceed with assumptions, present a numbered text list and wait for the reply
Phase 2 does not start until Phase 1 is complete; no bypass path exists
Parse the hypothesis and carry forward known enabling constraints and criteria without rediscovering them; if no hypothesis is present, ask for one and do not proceed
Identify enabling constraints that bound the experiment without prescribing the path: scope, immutable and variable
Define confirmed, refuted and surprise criteria before Phase 2 executes, and gate on this
Present the probe plan and classify the probe type: architecture, library, prompt, integration or design
Use one AskUserQuestion entry gate (Yes, Revise hypothesis, Revise criteria, Abort); anything other than confirmation loops back to the qualify steps
Run Phase 2 with worktree isolation and in the background, only after the entry gate passes
Execute probe steps with minimal, reversible actions and sparse gates; enabling constraints bound the agent
Sense patterns against the criteria: what signal emerged, what was unexpected, what constraints were discovered
MUST persist the thinking artifact before the exit gate, using the collision-numbering rule, and warn and skip if no workspace is configured
Classify the result as confirmed, refuted, partial or surprise
Select the handoff template from the table: confirmed or sufficient partial to investigate, partial needing another angle to probe, refuted or surprise to brainstorm
Keep the handoff within the token budget: target 300, flex 200 to 500, hard cap 600; compress prior cycles to 200 tokens at an 800-token accumulated cap
NEVER run a probe with production traffic
NEVER treat probe results as proof
NEVER design an irreversible probe
NEVER skip Phase 1 qualification
NEVER carry a failed hypothesis forward unchanged
